PreToolUse.name: worktree-session-binding-guard
PreToolUse.description: Enforces contracts §19 — 1 session = 1 worktree. BLOCK any file/git op outside BOUND worktree; requires AskUserQuestion for re-bind.

PostToolUse.name: 3layer-non-duplication-guard
PostToolUse.description: Enforces HARD STOP 3-Layer Architecture: Layer 1/2 (user_rules, CHE_RULES/COMMANDS) are title+link only. Layer 3 skills/*/SKILL.md owns the rule BODY. Warns with additionalContext when >=4 identical lines found in both Layer 1/2 AND any Layer 3 SKILL.md; never blocks post-hoc but flags to agent.

PostToolUse.name: lang-pt-text-detector-warn-only
PostToolUse.description: WARN-only (never blocks): detects Portuguese text in files written via Edit/Write (4+ PT stopword hits OR 2+ diacritics lines + 2 PT words). Never auto-fixes. Signals the agent to AskUserQuestion: (A) translate to EN, (B) keep PT, (C) disable for this session. Per-session disable via Level1 registry FLAGS: LANG_PT_CHECK=DISABLED on BOUND entry.

PostToolUse.name: git-worktree-auto-l3-manage
PostToolUse.description: AUTO-only (never blocks, never wraps git): detects `git worktree add` commands via RunCommand/Bash to auto-create L3 worktree shared dirs (ensure_session_dirs). Detects `git worktree remove/prune` to auto-move L3 dir to lixeira (.trash). Canonical git command is always the primary API; this hook enriches the Che 4-level hierarchy transparently.
